_doc: AUTHORITATIVE stated design values, transcribed verbatim from the rev5 SSOT README.md §Tokens (docs/design/language-screens/README.md:50-56). Owner directive 2026-08-07: the SSOT STATES these values; use them. Measure (extract-specs.mjs) ONLY what is not stated here. Where a measured value conflicts with a stated one, the STATED value wins (reconcile.mjs reports the conflicts). This file is the golden source of record for colour/type/metrics; specs/*.json is the measured layer for unstated per-frame positions + conflict detection.

colors._source: README.md:52-54 (Material 3, Google Blue). Role names map to androidx.compose.material3.ColorScheme.

measuredUnstated._doc: Values NOT listed in README §Tokens, so legitimately MEASURED from the drawings (the owner's 'measure only the unstated' rule). Landed in #348. Any role absent from both tiers is unstated -> measure from the drawing or take the M3 default, and record which.

type._note: Sizes are stated; weights are NOT stated in README §Tokens -> weight is an unstated value (measure it, or take the M3 default for the role: e.g. titleLarge=Regular/400).
